facts.fact: CBC reports that Edmonton-based Karaar Digital Address has run multiple test pilots of a digital system assigning verifiable addresses to properties in Somalia, including in Merca, and has signed memorandums of understanding with four states and regions.

SOM.note: The document states nothing about a census or household survey.
The document states nothing about a population register.
The document states nothing about civil registration.
The document states nothing about a social registry.
The document states no startup law, strategy or public fund for Somalia.
The document states nothing about a tax register.
The document names no hub, incubator or park in Somalia.
